home.title: Welcome to Worklume
home.body: Your workspace is being set up. Time tracking, timesheets and reports will appear here as they launch.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: This page couldn't load. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

capabilities.heading: What this device can't fully measure

reason.not_implemented: This version of Worklume can't measure it on this operating system yet.
reason.no_graphical_session: The agent isn't running in a desktop session.
reason.adapter_failed: The agent couldn't read it. It checks again every minute.
reason.permission_denied: The operating system didn't give Worklume permission.
reason.consent_not_asked: The member's desktop asks them to share their screen at the first screenshot.
reason.consent_dialog_open: The member's desktop is asking them to share their screen.
reason.consent_declined: The member declined screen sharing, so no screenshots are taken. They can choose to be asked again in the Worklume app.
reason.no_screencast_portal: The member's desktop doesn't offer screen sharing to apps.
reason.estimated_from_idle: Estimated second by second from the desktop's idle notices, not from each key press and click.
reason.no_keyboard_mouse_split: Keyboard and mouse aren't counted separately.
reason.idle_inhibitors_count_as_active: While a video or another app keeps the screen awake, the member counts as active.
reason.gnome_extension_next_login: Starts after the member next logs in to their desktop.
reason.gnome_extension_disabled: The member turned off the Worklume GNOME extension.
reason.gnome_extension_failed: GNOME couldn't run the Worklume extension.
reason.desktop_unsupported: The member's desktop doesn't let apps read it.
